title: pdfmarkuptool review-session Firestore documents
description: The stored shape of the Firestore documents the markup review loop shares between pdfmarkuptool (the SPA, zod in apps/pdfmarkuptool/src/types/schemas.ts, drift-tested against this file), the Cloud Functions, and pdf-cli's markups.* verbs (typed Go structs; every emulator-test write is validated against a byte-identical vendored copy). Single source per architecture review 2026-09-23, 1.2. One definition per collection (review contract v7: ReviewerEvent replaces ReviewSignal; a proposal is request + review, the legacy delta is read-only); the document id is the path segment and is never a field. Encoding for validation: a Firestore Timestamp is written as {seconds, nanoseconds} (its JSON form); every other value is its JSON value.

ownerEmail.description: Empty for a drafter-owned review session. Read as '' when absent.

sessionKind.description: Present only on a review session created by the drafter (markups.session-new).

sheetMap.description: DEPRECATED (2026-09-25, organizing model v3): sheet number -> 1-BASED page. 1-based is what every writer has always stored: pdf-cli's markups.session-new and legacy markups.ingest write the package's 1-based page (pages.json / titleblock.json / marks.json page), and review.ingest writes the same values as sheetPages (1-based position in set; for a one-document session that is the document's page). The '0-based' wording this field carried from 2026-09-23 to 2026-09-25 was wrong, and the first review.ingest build wrote 0-based values (never deployed). No released SPA reads the values (FirestoreService passes the map through untouched). New readers use set / sheetPages.

sheetPages.description: Service-only (review.ingest): sheet number -> 1-based position in the Set index (set). Present when the set's pages carry sheet_number.

set.description: Service-only (review.ingest / document.upsert): THE SET INDEX -- the combined view ACROSS ALL DOCUMENTS of the project, in 1-based display order (entry i is display page i + 1). Each entry names a page by its stable page_id and the document revision it comes from (page = its page in that revision's PDF). An ingest of document d replaces d's block in place; an upsert updates d's surviving entries in place, drops removed ones and appends new ones after d's block (a new document: at the end); recombination is a rewrite of this list. Absent on a session never ingested through the service.

documentId.description: The default document of a review session (pdf-cli session-new). A project may hold many documents (document control): readers open the first Set document, else this one.

reviewCore.description: Drafter-only (wiki spec--review-revamp R5): the project's review core; 2 = the request store (review-request-contract.json gate). Absent on a v8 project.

requestNumber.description: Service-only (U2, review-request-contract.json number.counter): the highest request number assigned so far on a reviewCore 2 project; request.dispatch takes 1 + it and writes it back in the same transaction.

version.description: THE package revision counter: 1 at session-new, +1 per markups.ingest. The SPA subscribes to it to swap the sheet live. With revisions it equals the current revision's n (kept in sync for old readers).

revision.description: Service-only (review.ingest / document.upsert, compare-and-set): the id of the CURRENT immutable revision (documents/{d}/revisions/{revision}). Absent on a document never ingested through the service. storagePath/packageHash/version mirror that revision (document.upsert: its assembled PDF).

source.description: Service-only (document.upsert): where the document comes from -- a bim-cli driver + its source document id / file, or driver 'none' (a sketch document).

packageVersion.description: DEPRECATED (2026-09-23): a second counter for the same job as `version`, never consumed. pdf-cli no longer writes it; readers must use `version`. Kept here only so documents written before the change still validate.

Revision.$comment: projects/{projectId}/documents/{documentId}/revisions/{revisionId} -- IMMUTABLE (organizing model v3, decision 2): written once by review.ingest or document.upsert inside its compare-and-set transaction, never updated or deleted; no client write (rules). revisionId = 'r' + n. A review.ingest revision is one whole package (packageHash + storagePath); a document.upsert revision (document control, wiki spec--document-control) is a list of CONTENT-ADDRESSED pages (page_hash, sidecar_hash) + docdata + diff, and carries packageHash + storagePath only when it has an assembled PDF (phase-1 compat).

n.description: 1-based revision number of the document; continues the document's version counter.

storagePath.description: The storage object of THIS revision. Never overwritten: every revision is a new object.

pages.description: Every page of this revision, in page order (page 1..N).

parent.description: The revision this one was ingested on (the compare-and-set base); null for the document's first revision.

docdata.description: document.upsert: source document id -> sha256 hex of its document data (projects/{p}/docdata/{h}.json: elements, levels, schedules -- model-scoped, never copied into page slices).

changed.description: Same page_id, another page_hash (ANY canonical byte change).

diff.description: document.upsert: page_ids against the parent revision.

assembled.description: document.upsert, PHASE-1 COMPAT: the whole assembled PDF (projects/{p}/assembled/{documentId}-r{n}-{sha8}.pdf) the single-PDF viewer opens; dropped when the viewer assembles pages.

mode.description: document.upsert: how the page list was sent.

op_hash.description: document.upsert: sha256 of the canonical call minus op_id -- a replay with another call under the same op_id is refused.

op_id.description: The ingest's / upsert's idempotency key: a repeated call with this op_id is replayed.

driver.description: The bim-cli driver that rendered it (pages.json source.driver), or 'none' for a sketch document.

document_id.description: The stable source document id (pages.json source.document_id).

PageId.description: Stable page identity (bim-pdf 1.12 pages.json page_id = source document_id + ':' + native_key). Survives page reordering and recombination; the page INDEX is display-only.

page_hash.description: document.upsert: sha256 hex of the CANONICAL single-page PDF at projects/{p}/pages/{page_hash}.pdf -- the page's identity (any byte change = changed).

sidecar_hash.description: document.upsert: sha256 hex of the page slice at projects/{p}/sidecars/{sidecar_hash}.json.

geometry.description: pages.json geometry. A change between two revisions parks the page's markups (page geometry changed).

DrawnOn.description: The document revision a markup / stroke / intent was drawn on (organizing model v3, decision 1).

PairingCode.$comment: projects/{projectId}/pairingCodes/{sha256hex(code)} -- Admin SDK only; no client may read or write.

ReviewerEvent.$comment: projects/{projectId}/reviewer_events/{eventId} -- review contract v7 reviewerEvents (replaces the v6 signals subcollection and the v5 Reject note); v8 adds restore/reapply (operations, item 1): append-only, created by an active admin/editor (by == the caller uid, at == request.time, closed shape, per-type required fields), read and deleted by the drafter (Admin SDK) after consuming. No client reads, updates or deletes one.

type.description: note = the text of a Reject (meant something else); dismiss = drop the intent trace_id; select_alternative = the reading picked in an Accept (index); dispatch = the reviewer names exactly what the drafter should read now (scope + markup_ids/page); restore = restore the operation op_id (contract v8); reapply = reapply the operation op_id, optionally a different alternative (index); release (2026-10-06, additive) = the reviewer released the dispatched markups markup_ids (their lock cleared; the drafter drops an unanswered intent over them); reading.correct (2026-10-01, additive) = the reviewer corrects the drafter's READING of the intent trace_id (text = what the ink actually says; the drafter cancels the draft and re-drafts from it). Enum equals the keys of contract reviewerEvents.types (tested).

trace_id.description: The intent the gesture is about (required for note, dismiss, select_alternative, reading.correct).

text.description: note: the reviewer text; reading.correct: the corrected reading. maxLength equals reviewerEvents.types.note.maxLength and reviewerEvents.types['reading.correct'].maxLength (tested).

index.description: select_alternative: the index into review.alternatives the Accept picked (maximum = select.maxAlternatives - 1, tested). reapply: OPTIONAL -- run a different alternative of the same proposal.

scope.description: dispatch: what to read -- selection (exactly markup_ids), page (exactly that page's undispatched strokes), document (every undispatched stroke). Enum equals reviewerEvents.types.dispatch.scopeRequires keys (tested).

markup_ids.description: dispatch scope selection: the reviewer's exact selected markup ids (the SPA filters to their own open/grounded/rejected/needs-human markups; the drafter re-checks).

page.description: dispatch scope page: the page (markups' pageNumber) to dispatch.

op_id.description: restore / reapply (contract v8): the operation (projects/{p}/operations/{op_id}) the reviewer gesture is about.

Operation.$comment: projects/{projectId}/operations/{opId} -- contract v8 (item 1): one record per operation (apply/restore/reapply/render) the review loop makes to a source document. Server/drafter-written (Admin SDK / bim-cli service principal), never client-written; project members read (firestore.rules `match /operations/{opId}`, hand-written like `/intents/{traceId}` -- a literal collection path is not generator-driven).

request.description: The forward request that ran (apply), or that this op's inverse re-runs (restore/reapply).

restore_plan.description: The inverse plan verified at propose (contract v8 item 4: strategy verb | preimage | script | none).

of_op.description: restore / reapply only: the operation being restored or reapplied.

pressures.description: freehand only: pen pressure per point, parallel to points. Optional (absent on mouse strokes and pre-2026-09-24 ink).

move.description: type move only (2026-10-08, additive): the element move this markup asks for. Required on a move markup, absent on every other type.

media.description: 2026-10-14 (image markup, additive): the markup's photos -- a map keyed by a client-generated item id, so every edit is a dotted-path write (media.<id>) and concurrent adds merge. Any type may carry up to 24; an image holds exactly 1 and a photo-pin 1..24 (both require it).

seq.description: photo-pin only: the in-app label hint (P12); final numbers are assigned at export.

heading.description: photo-pin only: the view direction on the page in degrees, [0, 360).

room.description: photo-pin only: the room the pin was placed in, a snapshot taken at link time.

page_id.description: The stable identity of the page the markup is on (organizing model v3). review.ingest re-anchors by it: pageNumber follows the page; a removed page or a changed page geometry parks the markup. Absent = a markup from before revisions (pageNumber only, left as is).

in_reply_to.description: Drafter-only: the proposal reply callout points at the human's markup.

delta.description: LEGACY (contract v2-v6), read-only: a pre-v7 proposal. pdf-cli >= 0.7.0 never writes it; the drafter upgrades the document to request + review on its next write (markups.upgrade does a whole session). Readers use core deltaView() / reviewRecordOf().

needs_human_reason.description: Drafter-only: why the markup moved to needs-human.

dispatch_id.description: 2026-10-06 (contract dispatchLock): the dispatch event id that grouped and LOCKED this markup; cleared by Reopen / Release. While set, a client write touches only status fields + dispatch_id / released; no delete.

released.description: 2026-10-06 (contract dispatchLock): a resolved / restored markup the reviewer Released -- hidden with its request (sheet and rail); the request record keeps it.

request_id.description: Service-only (wiki spec--review-revamp R5, review-request-contract.json inkField): the request (trace_id) this ink belongs to on a reviewCore 2 project; null once a Release before Accept freed it. Never written by a client.

proposal_markup_id.description: Drafter-only (markups.propose, on EVERY addressed markup): id of the proposal reply callout. May point at a deleted markup after a Reject or a withdraw.

addresses.description: Drafter-only (markups.propose, on the proposal REPLY): the markup ids the proposal covers, the primary (grounded, carrying the delta and the apply journal) first. The reply and every addressed markup share one group (groupId -> a type group markup).

proposal_expires_at.description: Drafter-only (markups.propose, on the original and the reply): after this a proposed markup is swept to needs-human.

resolved_package_hash.description: Drafter-only (markups.ingest): the package hash the markup was resolved (or failed to re-anchor) against.

sheet_anchor.description: Drafter-only (markups.ground --anchor sheet:..., contract v4): the placement region a CREATION intent is anchored to when no BIM element lies under it (linkedElementIds stays empty). markups.ingest resolves the set while the new package still has this sheet.

contractVersion.description: Review contract version of this document (7). Written by pdf-cli >= 0.7.0 on every markup of a proposal set (members, reply, group). Absent = a client-created markup or a pre-v7 document (read the legacy delta).

trace_id.description: Contract v7 ONE IDENTITY, drafter-only: the intent (reviewer gesture) this markup belongs to -- on every member, the reply and the group of a proposal set, equal to review.trace_id. Required at contractVersion >= 7 in the proposed band (proposed/accepted/applying).

request.description: Contract v7, drafter-only (primary + reply): the executable half of the proposal.

review.description: Contract v7, drafter-only except review.selected (the Accept): the record half of the proposal.

allOf.$comment: seq / heading / room exist on a photo-pin only.
v7: a contractVersion >= 7 markup in the proposed band carries trace_id (enum equals the contract locked statuses, tested).
v7: a contractVersion >= 7 markup never carries the legacy delta; request and review come together.

MarkupMove.description: 2026-10-08 (element move, MOVE-COMMON): a request to move ONE model element in the plane of the view it is drawn in. points = [from, to] (canvas space, like an arrow: the element centre before and after); linkedElementIds = [element_id]. The drafter maps delta_pt to a model delta by the view's own basis (no drafting step).

element_id.description: The element (elements.json id) to move; equals linkedElementIds[0].

page_vp.description: Index into scales.json pages[page].viewports: the viewport the element is drawn in.

delta_pt.description: [dx, dy] in PDF points, RAW page user space, Y-UP (the marks.json bbox convention; /Rotate undone, MediaBox origin irrelevant to a delta).

kind.description: The osnap kind the release landed on (endpoint, midpoint, intersection, center, nearest).

to.description: The element id snapped to, when the target was an element (a wall line); absent for page content.

constraint.description: free = any direction; axis = locked horizontal / vertical; host = slid along its host wall (a door / window).

Media.description: 2026-10-14 (image markup): a markup's photos, keyed by item id (client-generated, stable). At most 24 items.

MediaItem.description: One photo: a reference to a content-addressed asset (projects/{p}/assets/{asset}.jpg once promoted) and its metadata -- never the bytes.

asset.description: sha256 (lowercase hex) of the stored bytes.

mime.description: v1 writes image/jpeg only; png is reserved.

order.description: Display order; the cover is the lowest. Fractional inserts allowed.

capturedAt.description: ms epoch, only from a meaningful file date; absent -> addedAt.

url.description: The http(s) URL the copy carried (image src or link href).

MarkupRoom.description: photo-pin only: the room under the pin, a snapshot taken at link time (auto = resolved from the package; typed = typed or picked by the user).

AgentStatus.description: Drafter-only LIVE PROGRESS (the drafter via pdf-cli, Admin SDK): written on every markup of an intent and overwritten per stage; cleared, or left at done / failed. Clients may never create or change it (firestore.rules createsNoDrafterFields / touchesNoDrafterFields). Display only: nothing in the review loop reads it as state.

stage.description: applied (2026-10-01, additive): the apply returned and the loop is now exporting + ingesting the sheet (the SPA shows Applied -- updating sheet... until done / failed).

text.description: What the drafter is doing, in the reviewer's words (e.g. Read as 'move door').

at.description: ISO 8601 datetime string of this stage's write (same encoding as StatusHistoryEntry.at).

SheetAnchor.description: A declared placement on a sheet: the sheet number (a key of the project sheetMap) and a region in SHEET FEET measured from the sheet's lower-left corner (x right, y up); x_ft/y_ft is the region's TOP-LEFT corner (where Revit places a schedule's origin), w_ft extends right and h_ft extends DOWN from it. The region is optional: a bare sheet anchor carries only `sheet`.

Timestamp.description: A Firestore Timestamp, in its JSON form.

type.description: Fixed per actor by review-contract.json actors[].byType.

at.description: ISO 8601 string (same encoding as annotations.json), NOT a Timestamp.

event.description: History-only marker, not a status: `executed-resolved` (contract v6 executedResolve) on the drafter's resolved entry when markups.resolve --executed resolved a handed-back set whose delta already ran -- its reason is the recorded result JSON; `withdrawn` on the drafter's proposed -> open entry (older history: the removed pdf-cli markups.withdraw; contract requiresReason: its reason is required); `apply-refused` on the drafter's needs-human entry when markups.apply refused an accepted set -- its reason is the refusal; `anchor-declared` (contract v4) on the drafter's grounded entry when markups.ground --anchor declared the anchor -- its reason is the anchor spec (element:<id> or sheet:<number>[@x,y,w,h]).

reason.description: Free text recorded with the entry (the drafter's withdraw or apply-refused reason).

note.description: LEGACY (contract v5-v6), read-only: the note of a human Reject on its rejected entry. Contract v7 carries it as a reviewer_events note (the rules deny a new entry with a note); old entries keep it.

base_rev.description: The PRIMARY markup's rev when the proposal became visible: after all of markups.propose's writes (pdf-cli >= 0.6.0). Informational since pdf-cli 0.6.3: markups.apply checks invariants (status_history, delta.hash, package), not rev arithmetic. Only a LEGACY delta without `hash` is still held to rev == base_rev + 1 (base_rev + 2 when base_revs is absent too).

base_revs.description: Every addressed markup's rev when the proposal became visible (primary included), keyed by markup id (pdf-cli >= 0.6.0). Informational since pdf-cli 0.6.3 (see base_rev); a legacy delta without `hash` still requires each member at exactly +1.

hash.description: pdf-cli >= 0.6.3: sha256 of the canonical JSON (sorted keys) of this delta without `hash`, written by markups.propose. markups.apply refuses (delta-changed) when the stored delta no longer hashes to it. Contract v5: the hash covers `alternatives` and EXCLUDES `selected`.

alternatives.description: Contract v5 READING ALTERNATIVES, drafter-only (markups.propose, on the primary's delta and the reply's copy): the candidate readings of an uncertain intent, best first; alternatives[0] equals the top-level driver/verb/args. maxItems equals humanFieldWrites.selection.maxAlternatives (tested).

selected.description: Contract v5: the ONE client write into a drafter field -- an index into `alternatives`, written by the human Accept (proposed -> accepted) on the PRIMARY only, as the field path delta.selected in the same write (rules: 0 <= selected < alternatives.size()). markups.apply runs alternatives[selected] (absent = 0). Excluded from `hash`.

revision_of.description: Contract v6 (deltaTrace.revisionOf), drafter-only: the id of the proposal reply this proposal REVISES -- the drafter withdrew that proposal (proposed -> open, event withdrawn) because a late stroke joined the intent, and re-proposed with it. Covered by `hash`. The SPA shows an updated marker and a previous-version disclosure.

revision.description: Contract v6 (deltaTrace.revision), drafter-only: which revision of the intent this proposal is (1 = first; absent reads as 1). Covered by `hash`.

previous_summary.description: Contract v6 (deltaTrace.previousSummary), drafter-only: the summary of the proposal this one revises (the withdraw deleted its reply), shown in the SPA previous-version disclosure. Covered by `hash`.

trace_id.description: Contract v6 (deltaTrace.traceId), drafter-only: the INTENT trace id, the same on every revision of one intent. The SPA attaches it to its review telemetry (proposal_card_action, markup_status_changed). pattern equals deltaTrace.traceIdPattern (tested). Covered by `hash`.

MarkupDelta.description: LEGACY (contract v2-v6), read-only in v7: the pre-split proposal. See MarkupRequest + MarkupReview.

MarkupRequest.description: Contract v7: the EXECUTABLE half of a proposal. markups.apply runs `bim <driver> <verb> --<arg> ...` of it (or of review.alternatives[review.selected].request).

preimage.description: Pre-edit state of the touched element(s).

base_package_hash.description: The package the request was computed against; apply refuses stale-package when the session package changed (only when base_revisions is absent or the caller cannot read revisions).

base_revisions.description: The revision model: {documentId: revision} of every document the request was computed against. Apply refuses stale-revision when one of THOSE documents has a newer revision; another document's re-export does not stale it.

script.description: A drafted script the request runs (revit exec of a generated .cs): its path and content hash, so the record says exactly what ran.

MarkupReview.description: Contract v7: the RECORD half of a proposal. hash = 'sha256:' + sha256 of the canonical JSON of {request, review minus hash, selected and outcome} (packages/core reviewHash, pdf-cli ReviewHash; conformance/review/vectors.json).

summary.description: The change in the reviewer's words (the card and the reply text).

base_rev.description: Informational: the primary's rev when the proposal became visible.

base_revs.description: Informational: every addressed markup's rev when the proposal became visible.

alternatives.description: Candidate readings, best first; alternatives[0].request equals {driver, verb, args} of `request`. maxItems equals select.maxAlternatives (tested).

selected.description: The ONE client write into a drafter field: the index the human Accept picked (field path review.selected, same write as proposed -> accepted). Not hashed.

revision_of.description: The reply id of the proposal this one revises (a re-draft: the reviewer Rejected it with a note and the drafter re-proposed).

previous_summary.description: The revised proposal's summary, shown in the previous-version disclosure.

ReviewAlternative.description: Contract v7: one candidate reading of a proposal (review.alternatives[i]).

ReviewOutcome.description: Contract v7, drafter-only, not hashed: what happened when the request ran. applied = a model edit ran; filed = the bug route filed an issue (driver linear); executed = markups.resolve --executed resolved a handed-back set whose request already ran; failed = the call failed (result = the error).

op_id.description: Contract v8: the operation record (projects/{p}/operations/{op_id}) this outcome's apply created.

TraceId.description: Contract v7 trace.pattern (tested): the one identity key of a reviewer gesture / intent.

DeltaAlternative.description: Contract v5: one candidate reading of a proposal (MarkupDelta.alternatives).

summary.description: The change in the reviewer's words, shown as one radio row on the review card.

ApplyJournal.description: Drafter-only (markups.apply): the idempotency journal of one apply attempt.
